question: Which of the following animals is NOT a mammal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2) Lizard**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lizard** is not a mammal; it is a reptile.
 
• Mammals are warm-blooded vertebrates that have hair or fur and whose females have mammary glands for feeding milk to their young.
 
• Examples of mammals include **dolphins, bats, and elephants**, all of which give birth to live young
